summary: APM feed s053_single is degraded: required VLAN 20 is missing (50% packets untagged) while all other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, truncation, drops, overload, tunnels, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags or trunk is misconfigured as access/untagged. Required VLAN 20 is not forwarded to the APM tool port, resulting in 50% untagged packets instead of tagged VLAN 20 traffic.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM requires both VLANs 10 and 20 for tier/segment-aware performance monitoring. Missing VLAN 20 blinds the APM to half the application traffic, breaks transaction correlation by segment, and prevents accurate latency/error attribution per VLAN.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker ingress/egress to preserve and passthrough 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 end-to-end to the APM, ensuring VLAN 20 is not stripped or filtered.
